title: Data Cleaning
description: Master the cleaning patterns every Pandas practitioner reaches for daily: deduplication, missing-value strategies, categorical binning, type fixes, and the subtle Pandas gotchas that distort results when uncaught.
outcomes: You'll choose imputation strategies that don't introduce bias, deduplicate with the right key choice, bin continuous values into useful categories, debug Pandas's silent gotchas (SettingWithCopyWarning, sort-before-cumsum), and reach for the right tool when data arrives messy.
